# [TEACHING]{.second-color}
Our courses widen the landing strip for new arrivals into the Data Science We cover foundational topics in thorough and inclusive ways, as well offer deep-dives into specialist subjects: Statistics, Programming in R and Python, Text Analysis, Visualisation and more.

## Master in Data Science for Health and Social Care

Our flagship MSc program (online, part-time, 3 years) attracts two types of students:

- Health and Social Care professionals get an opportunity to upskill in Data Science and research practices;
- Data Science professionals with interest in health can build stronger foundations in health and social care applications and research.

Below is a list of some of our most popular courses.

:::{#ms-dshsc}
:::

## Short courses

Our team also created a number of online short courses:

- paid certified courses (10-15 hours of materials);
- free taster courses (1-1.5 hours of materials).

They are a way to upskill, and to sample how some of our learning on the MSc program looks like.
